headline: CLE @ DET matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CLE 4.51 at DET 3.98, with a projected total of 8.49. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward CLE: CLE moved -0.18 runs while DET moved -0.50, changing the projected margin by +0.32 runs. The projected total fell -0.68, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +9.3%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Casey Mize has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Riley Greene, Travis Bazzana, Angel Martínez, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Gage Workman, Spencer Torkelson because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
